item: D5 Selection of the reported result
support_quote: comprises three subscales: individual reasons, environmental reasons, and amotivation
reasoning: Both judges read the paper correctly. The Methods describe the MSPPA's three subscales and its total ('scored from 16 to 80'), and the Results give only the total. Judge 1's second ground, selection among analyses, does not meet any High clause as written: those clauses name outcome, time point and subscales. The absolute, change-score and ANCOVA results are all reported, and only the Abstract's emphasis differs. So the rating turns only on whether a total reported in place of the subscales is 'only some of the subscales', which is the same question escalated for pm-40567995. The registration predates recruitment, but its content is not in the saved text, so Low is not shown either way. The user's question is the same: does a total or composite reported in place of every subscale the Methods describe meet D5 High?
